integrity: Proof combines a standard all-size logic theorem with two reproducible, independently implemented exact finite enumerations; no claim for larger DAGs.
scientific_limitations: Full directed one-dimensional colour refinement and C2 equivalence only for finite, nonempty, loopless simple DAGs of at most six vertices; prior specialist enumerations may exist. The known numbers of DAG isomorphism types and general C2/colour-refinement equivalence are not newly asserted. No external audit or publication-priority certification.
title: The unique six-vertex colour-refinement collision among finite directed acyclic graphs
